spanish: Sobre toda palabra de delito, sobre buey, sobre asno, sobre oveja o cabra, sobre vestido, sobre toda pérdida que diga que él esto, hasta los dioses vendrá palabra de ambos; al que condenen dioses, pagará dos a su compañero.
grammarChanges: h02022009010 (שֶׂה): replaced «cordero» with «oveja o cabra» so the word covers either flock animal instead of narrowing to a young sheep.
h02022009022 (הָאֱלֹהִים): replaced «Dios» (singular, capitalized) with «los dioses» (plural, lowercase, definite) to match the definite masculine plural noun and avoid reading it as a divine title.
h02022009018 (כִּי): replaced «Porque» with «que» so the conjunction stays unmarked instead of selecting a causal sense.
h02022009019-h02022009020 (הוּא זֶה): reordered «esto él» to «él esto» to match the pronoun-then-demonstrative sequence.
readerNote: «oveja o cabra» renders שֶׂה because Spanish has no single word covering either flock animal without specifying age or species.
